title: The Belmont Garden Cottage
description:
Located across the street from Belmont University! Walk to Hillsboro Village, 12th South or take a quick Uber (2 miles) to the Gulch/Downtown. Perfect for those visiting Belmont, Vandy, or downtown. Tuck into the backyard of a Nashville native and live like a local.

Guest access
This is a separate cottage on our property, located just behind our home.  The guest will have full use of the cottage and its patio.

Other things to note
The back office (listed as 2nd bedroom) contains a standard size single bed which spans the full length of the room - so it is not ideal for someone who is taller than a standard single. There is a separate space heater and fan that works pretty well to pul cool air from the bedroom. However, there is not a separate wall unit in this room.
